name: Acheron
faction: Independent (claims to be a Galaxy Ranger; is truly an Emanator of Nihility)
description: Real name Raiden Bosenmori Mei, Acheron presents herself as a Galaxy Ranger fighting for justice, but is in truth an Emanator granted power by the Aeon of Nihility. Hailing from the planet Izumo, she ended her homeland's destructive cycle by forging a final blade and experiences time in a non-linear way.
